name: describe_open_scheduler_view
description: Read back which delivery date's capacity panel the just-opened Delivery Scheduler page is showing. Optional confirmation step only: the merchant is already on the right page once the action has run, so only call this if you need to state on screen what they are looking at. This tool never changes a delivery date, time slot or capacity. Do not call this tool to verify navigation - it is inactive and a non-response never means the page failed to open.

deliveryDate.description: Delivery date the scheduler's day panel is focused on, YYYY-MM-DD.
